datasets.title: Sector context for thin observatory coverage

datasets.title: Asia–Africa bilateral merchandise corridors
datasets.description: UN Comtrade annual export flows for coffee, tea, cocoa, rice, cashew, palm oil, cotton, and knitted shirts. Values under USD 1 million are omitted. The public preview quota stopped this extract before every listed reporter finished; a missing pair is not zero trade.

datasets.title: Observatory SQLite database
datasets.description: Queryable copy of WDI observations, market references, organization profiles, bilateral corridors, and the media brief.
